warnings: *** A FOURTH DRAWING NUMBER: EE 62062. *** The set now has S 62047 (structural), AR 61142 (architectural), SN 62034 (sanitary) and EE 62062 (electrical) -- four separately numbered submissions for one house, all ม.ค. 2562.

*** THE SYMBOL TABLE CARRIES A MOUNTING HEIGHT FOR ALMOST EVERY DEVICE, and those heights are the A-03 accessibility brief made real: switches at 0.90 m (A-03 requires not more than 0.90), sockets at 0.45 m (A-03 requires at least 0.45), RJ45 outlets also at 0.45, TV outlet at 0.90. *** The electrical engineer clearly worked to the same brief.
Two heights DEPART from that pattern for good reason: the weatherproof WP socket sits at 1.30 m (outdoors, above splash) and the daylight switch at 2.50 m. Neither is a circulation device.

LUMINAIRES ARE SPECIFIED BY PERFORMANCE, NOT MODEL: batten LED T8 not more than 20 W, COOL WHITE, at least 1,600 lm and at least 25,000 h life; downlight 100-125 mm, E27 LED not more than 7 W, WARM WHITE, at least 600 lm; wall light the same lamp in a UV-resistant aluminium weatherproof body. Every figure is a MINIMUM or a MAXIMUM, never a target.
COLOUR TEMPERATURE IS DELIBERATELY SPLIT: COOL WHITE for the batten fittings, WARM WHITE for the downlights and wall lights.
BOTH CIRCUIT TYPES USE THE SAME CABLE AND CONDUIT -- IEC 01 2.5 sq.mm in ø15 mm PVC for lighting AND for sockets. There is no lighter lighting circuit, which simplifies the take-off considerably.
The ground rod is fully specified and countable: copper-bond or copper-clad steel to UL, ø14.20 mm x 2.40 m, top buried about 0.30 m below ground.

*** ONE ITEM IS EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE: the RB router position is 'โดยผู้ให้บริการ INTERNET ไม่รวมในงานนี้' -- the position is drawn but the equipment is the ISP's, not the contractor's. *** Do not price it.
JWH (water-heater connection box) appears in the legend, so a water heater is anticipated even though A-29's สุขภัณฑ์ list schedules no heater and SN-08's basin detail calls hot water '(ถ้ามี)'.
Eleven approved-brand lists are given, four of them tied to a มอก. number: conduit มอก.216-2524, cable มอก.11-2553, switches มอก.824-2531, sockets มอก.116-2549.
